installTagline: Add the game to your Home Screen to open it with one tap.
iosInstallBody: Add the game to your Home Screen to open it like a regular app.
iosInstallStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari — the square icon with an arrow
iosInstallStep2: In the menu, choose "Add to Home Screen"
iosInstallOutro: The game's icon will then appear on your iPhone's Home Screen.
openInSafariBody: To add the game to your Home Screen, open this page in Safari.
openInSafariStep3: Paste the link into the address bar
